fact: The DJ-CERT, inaugurated on 21 September 2023, took 16th and 18th places at the ITU Global CyberDrill in Dubai on 6-8 May 2025 and joined AfricaCERT.
title: Le DJ-CERT renforce son engagement international : participation au CyberDrill 2025 à Dubaï et à la formation « Cyber Disaster Response » à Maurice
